whyForBowfishing: Below a dam, what a bowfisher needs to know is simple: is the dam releasing or generating right now, and when will that change. Moving water pulls fish to the tailrace and changes where they hold and how safe the boat is, and a posted schedule lets you plan the night around the next start or stop. Flow numbers are useful detail but secondary. The score asks: for dam lakes, does the Brain say releasing or not (never unknown), and when it changes, from real operator data, and does that match what the operators posted?
measurement: Domain capability score (Cortex scoring.md SC-02, SC-03): how far Sector can trust the Generation Brain's published dam release picture (status, measured release, the operator's schedule). Not operational health, not production readiness, not comparable with any other Brain's score.
question: Per dam lake, does the Generation Brain say whether the dam is releasing or generating now (never unknown) and when that changes, current, from sources Sector is allowed to read, with parsers proven on real responses, and has that matched the operators' own schedules over the pre-registered week (GENERATION_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5)?
unknownPolicy: Unknown counts against the Brain everywhere (owner rule 2026-11-23: nothing should show unknown). A lake, tile or field that is unknown, unavailable, blocked or abstained earns 0 and stays in every denominator; a fact the Brain does not publish scores 0 and lowers completeness. Unknown is never rewarded or excluded to make a share look better. Filling an unknown with an estimate is worse still: it is an invented value, which the validation checks fail, so the only way to remove an unknown is real data. For Generation, a release status of UNKNOWN, and a dam lake with no published state, count against.
scope: Coverage over DAM lakes (/brains/generation.fleet.damLakeCount, 401 in catalog generation-dams-2026-11-22.1), not the 621-lake directory: the 220 lakes without a dam have no release by definition. Quality shares over supported lakes (/brains/generation.supportedLakeCount: state kind OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_ONLY). Validation fleet-wide.
dimensionClasses: Cortex scoring.md SC-09: CAP, COV, PRED, VAL, ENG, VOL. This draft has no ENG or VOL dimension.

dimensions.label: Pre-registered schedule comparison (plan section 5)
dimensions.note: The Brain writes NOT_VALIDATED today (validationVersion 'generation-validation-none (calibration)'). Meanings in validationStatusMeaning.
dimensions.why: A week of comparison with the operators' own schedules shows whether 'releasing now' and 'next change' can be trusted on the water.

dimensions.label: Releasing / generating now: a known status
dimensions.fact: /lakeFleet/{k}/slots/generation.status: share of published slots (every kind, UNAVAILABLE and DOWNSTREAM_ONLY included) whose status is GENERATING, SPILLING, RELEASING or OFF
dimensions.why: Whether water is moving at the dam right now is the first thing a tailrace bowfisher needs; UNKNOWN answers nothing and counts against.
dimensions.note: Every published slot is in the denominator, so an abstention (UNKNOWN) is never excluded. Discharge, turbine and spill numbers are secondary detail and are not scored separately.

dimensions.label: When it changes: operator schedule published where operators post one
dimensions.fact: count of /lakes/{k}/states/generation with a non-empty schedule.windows / (fleet.byGroup.TVA + fleet.byGroup.TVA_CUMBERLAND + fleet.byGroup.SWPA_USACE)
dimensions.note: Schedules (start / stop times) exist only for TVA, the TVA-published Cumberland projects and SWPA (plan section 3, about 39 lakes). The denominator is those groups, so binding more measured-only CWMS or RISE lakes never lowers this share (the scoring.md CG-2.8-4 concern).
dimensions.why: The next start or stop lets a bowfisher plan the night instead of guessing.

dimensions.label: Dam lakes with a published release picture
dimensions.note: Moves only with new bindings on allowed sources AND a live state from them (GEN-BIND-001..003). A catalog entry alone does not count: supportedLakeCount counts published OBSERVED / SCHEDULE_ONLY states.
dimensions.why: A dam lake with no release picture leaves the bowfisher guessing; it counts against.

dimensions.label: Supported lakes current (not stale)
dimensions.fact: /lakeFleet/{k}/slots/generation: share of lakes with kind OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_ONLY whose stale is false, over lakes with kind OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_ONLY
dimensions.population: One population for numerator and denominator: the supported lakes as their fleet slots show them. The registry staleLakeCount is not used: it also counts lakes that errored or are UNAVAILABLE (generation_brain/publish.py), which supportedLakeCount excludes, so the ratio could go below zero.
dimensions.note: A release picture past freshUntil is worse than none for the tile; the Brain marks it stale rather than serving it.
dimensions.why: An out-of-date 'releasing now' is wrong on the water, so stale lakes count against.

validationStatusMeaning.source: docs/brains/GENERATION_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5, registered before any run. Thresholds are the plan's (not restated or moved here); a FAIL is reported as a FAIL.
validationStatusMeaning.newInThisDraft: The plan says PASS needs all five metrics and a FAIL is reported as a FAIL; it defines no partial tier. The PARTIAL tier and its 7.0 cap are new in this draft and need the owner's approval.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: All five pre-registered metrics PASS (hour agreement, transition latency, schedule fidelity, no invented values, freshness) over the 7-day window (>= 2 weekdays, >= 1 weekend day) on every lake with a schedule bound and readable, at least the 17 bound today.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: Some of the five metrics PASS and the rest are NOT YET SCORED (for example metrics 4 and 5, checked on every published state, pass before the week ends); none FAILED.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Nothing scored yet, or ANY metric FAILED. A failed metric is never credited; the status stays NOT_VALIDATED until a new week, run under the same pre-registered thresholds, passes.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The validation record under docs/cortex/ (plan section 5) and the reviewed change that writes /validation/generation, never the scorer.
